brief: Bluecrest Staffing builds dedicated offshore teams in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam and Cebu, Philippines for companies in the US, UK and Australia. Founded 11 years ago. 620 staff across both offices. 96% of clients renew each year. Clients save up to 65% against a local hire. A new team is usually working within 14 days of signing. Certifications: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015. Clients include Harlow Freight, Northgate Dental, Pinecrest Insurance, Tallyworks Accounting, Orbit Home Goods and Kestrel Software. Roles by industry: finance and accounting (bookkeeper, accounts payable clerk, payroll officer, tax preparer), healthcare (patient support agent, medical billing specialist, insurance verification agent), logistics (dispatch coordinator, shipment tracking agent, freight billing clerk), ecommerce (order support agent, product listing editor, returns processor), software and IT (QA tester, help desk technician, data analyst), insurance (claims support agent, policy administrator, underwriting assistant), real estate (transaction coordinator, listing assistant, leasing support agent). Yearly cost per person, local US hire vs Bluecrest: bookkeeper 58000 vs 20300, customer support agent 49000 vs 16800, QA tester 84000 vs 29400. Process: define the team and goals, Bluecrest recruits and sets up the team, the team works as an extension of the client with monthly reporting. Talent pool of pre-vetted candidates, clients interview and approve every hire. Quotes: 'Bluecrest found us four bookkeepers in two weeks, and all four are still with us two years later.' Dana Whitfield, Finance Director, Tallyworks Accounting. 'Our claims backlog was gone within a quarter. The Cebu team follows our checklists better than we did.' Marcus Lee, Operations Manager, Pinecrest Insurance. 'We started with one QA tester and now run a team of nine. Reporting every month keeps us close to the work.' Priya Raman, VP Engineering, Kestrel Software. Offices: 12th Floor, 81 Cach Mang Thang Tam Street, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, phone (+84) 28 5555 0181; 9th Floor, Cebu IT Park, Lahug, Cebu City, phone (+63) 32 555 0147. Email: hello@bluecrest.example.
